definition_en: To stop sleeping and open your eyes.
example_en: I wake up at seven every morning.
example_uz: Men har kuni ertalab yettida uyg'onaman.

definition_en: To change from a child into an adult.
example_en: She grew up in a small village.

definition_en: To move your body into a sitting position.
example_en: Please sit down, the lesson is starting.

definition_en: To rise to your feet from sitting.
example_en: Everyone stood up when the teacher entered.

definition_en: To move or happen more slowly.
example_en: Slow down, you're driving too fast.

definition_en: To do something more quickly.
example_en: Hurry up, or we'll miss the bus!

definition_en: To put your name on a list to join something.
example_en: I signed up for a swimming course.

definition_en: To make a machine or light start working.
example_en: Turn on the light — it's getting dark.

definition_en: To make a machine or light stop working.
example_en: Don't forget to turn off the TV.

definition_en: To write something on paper so you remember it.
example_en: Write down my phone number.

definition_en: To get rid of something you no longer need.
example_en: Don't throw away those old photos.

definition_en: To look after someone or something.
example_en: She takes care of her younger brothers.

definition_en: To remove something unwanted.
example_en: We finally got rid of the old sofa.

definition_en: To enter a bus, train or plane.
example_en: We got on the bus at the main station.

definition_en: To leave a bus, train or plane.
example_en: Get off at the next stop.

definition_en: To continue happening or doing something.
example_en: The meeting went on for three hours.

definition_en: To leave home for entertainment.
example_en: We go out for dinner every Friday.

definition_en: To experience something difficult; to examine carefully.
example_en: She went through a difficult time last year.
example_uz: U o'tgan yili og'ir davrni boshdan kechirdi.

definition_en: To start or continue with a plan.
example_en: Go ahead, we're all listening.

definition_en: To look at something interesting; to leave a hotel.
example_en: Check out this new café near the park.
example_uz: Bog' yonidagi yangi kafega bir qarang.

definition_en: To eat at a restaurant instead of at home.
example_en: We eat out once a week.

definition_en: To wear special or formal clothes.
example_en: Everyone dressed up for the wedding.

definition_en: To complete a form with information.
example_en: Fill out this form and sign at the bottom.
example_uz: Bu formani to'ldirib pastiga imzo cheking.

definition_en: To make something completely full.
example_en: He filled up the tank before the trip.

definition_en: To meet with people socially.
example_en: The whole family gets together on holidays.

definition_en: To give something to someone for free.
example_en: She gave away most of her books.
example_uz: U kitoblarining ko'pini hadya qilib yubordi.

definition_en: To return something to its owner.
example_en: Give back my pen when you finish.

definition_en: To give work to a teacher or boss.
example_en: Hand in your essays by Friday.

definition_en: To give something to each person in a group.
example_en: The teacher handed out the exam papers.

definition_en: To end a phone call.
example_en: She said goodbye and hung up.

definition_en: To stop yourself from showing a feeling or doing something.
example_en: He couldn't hold back his tears.

definition_en: To take part in an activity with others.
example_en: Everyone joined in the singing.

definition_en: To continue doing something.
example_en: Keep on practising and you will improve.

definition_en: To begin — especially an event or a match.
example_en: The festival kicks off at noon on Saturday.

definition_en: To not include someone or something.
example_en: You left out an important detail.

definition_en: Used to warn someone about danger.
example_en: Look out, the floor is wet!

definition_en: To admire and respect someone.
example_en: Young players look up to the captain.

definition_en: To think you are better than someone.
example_en: Never look down on people with less money.
example_uz: Kam pulli odamlarni hech qachon mensimay qaramang.

definition_en: To do something good to balance something bad.
example_en: He bought flowers to make up for being late.
example_uz: Kechikkanining o'rnini to'ldirish uchun gul oldi.

definition_en: To confuse two things or people.
example_en: I always mix up the twins' names.

definition_en: To start living in a new home.
example_en: We moved in last month.

definition_en: To stop living in a home and leave it.
example_en: He moved out of his parents' house at twenty.
example_uz: U yigirma yoshida ota-onasining uyidan ko'chib chiqdi.

definition_en: To bring good results; to finish paying a debt.
example_en: All those hours of study finally paid off.
example_uz: Shuncha soatlik o'qish nihoyat o'zini oqladi.

definition_en: To choose something from a group.
example_en: She picked out a blue dress for the party.
example_uz: U bazm uchun ko'k ko'ylak tanlab oldi.

definition_en: To drive to the side of the road and stop.
example_en: The police asked him to pull over.

definition_en: To stop a fire or light from burning.
example_en: Firefighters put out the fire quickly.

definition_en: To leave a place quickly to escape.
example_en: The cat ran away from the dog.

definition_en: To decide something is impossible or not suitable.
example_en: Doctors ruled out anything serious.

definition_en: To be sold completely so none is left.
example_en: The concert tickets sold out in an hour.
example_uz: Konsert chiptalari bir soatda sotilib tugadi.

definition_en: To start a journey.
example_en: We set off early to avoid traffic.
example_uz: Tirbandlikka tushmaslik uchun erta yo'lga chiqdik.

definition_en: To start living a calm settled life.
example_en: They settled down in a quiet town.
example_uz: Ular tinch shaharchada muqim yashay boshlashdi.

definition_en: To try to impress people with what you have or can do.
example_en: He loves showing off his new phone.
example_uz: U yangi telefonini ko'z-ko'z qilishni yaxshi ko'radi.

definition_en: To close a business or stop a machine completely.
example_en: The factory shut down last year.

definition_en: To talk more loudly so people can hear.
example_en: Speak up, we can't hear you at the back.

definition_en: To end a relationship; to divide into parts.
example_en: The band split up after ten years.
example_uz: Guruh o'n yildan keyin tarqab ketdi.

definition_en: To be easy to notice because of being different or better.
example_en: Her red coat stood out in the crowd.
example_uz: Uning qizil paltosi olomon ichida ajralib turardi.

definition_en: To not go to bed at the usual time.
example_en: The kids stayed up late watching films.

definition_en: To continue with a plan or decision without changing it.
example_en: Stick to your study plan this month.
example_uz: Bu oy o'qish rejangizga amal qiling.

definition_en: To accept new work or responsibility; to employ.
example_en: Don't take on more work than you can handle.

definition_en: To remove something; to take someone somewhere as a guest.
example_en: He took out the rubbish before dinner.
example_uz: Kechki ovqatdan oldin axlatni olib chiqdi.

definition_en: A very small amount compared with what is needed.
example_en: My donation is just a drop in the ocean.
example_uz: Mening xayriyam dengizdan bir tomchi xolos.

definition_en: Working fast because there is little time.
example_en: We worked against the clock to finish the report.
example_uz: Hisobotni tugatish uchun vaqt bilan poyga qildik.

definition_en: Ready and eager to listen.
example_en: Tell me what happened — I'm all ears.
example_uz: Nima bo'lganini ayting — diqqat bilan eshitaman.

definition_en: Back to the beginning after a failure.
example_en: The plan failed, so we're back to square one.
example_uz: Reja barbod bo'ldi, yana boshiga qaytdik.

definition_en: Happening privately where people cannot see.
example_en: A lot of work happens behind the scenes.

definition_en: To try extremely hard to help someone.
example_en: She bent over backwards to make guests comfortable.
example_uz: U mehmonlar qulayligi uchun bor kuchini sarfladi.

headword: birds of a feather flock together
definition_en: Similar people tend to spend time together.
ipa: bɜːdz əv ə ˈfeðə flɒk təˈɡeðə
example_en: They're always together — birds of a feather flock together.
example_uz: Ular doim birga — o'xshash odamlar bir-birini topadi.

definition_en: To release strong feelings through activity.
example_en: He runs in the evening to blow off steam.
example_uz: U hovuridan tushish uchun kechqurun yuguradi.

definition_en: A way to wish someone good luck before a performance.
example_en: Break a leg at the audition tomorrow!

definition_en: To destroy relationships so you cannot go back.
example_en: Don't burn bridges when you leave a job.

definition_en: A nervous feeling before something important.
example_en: I had butterflies in my stomach before the interview.

definition_en: To catch someone while they are doing something wrong.
example_en: The guard caught the thief red-handed.
example_uz: Qorovul o'g'rini jinoyat ustida qo'lga tushirdi.

definition_en: Very calm even in a difficult situation.
example_en: She stayed cool as a cucumber during the exam.

definition_en: A lazy person who watches TV all day.
example_en: Don't be a couch potato — go outside!

headword: cross that bridge when you come to it
definition_en: To deal with a problem only when it actually happens.
ipa: krɒs ðæt brɪdʒ wen juː kʌm tuː ɪt
example_en: Don't worry now — we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
example_uz: Hozir xavotir olmang — muammoni kelganda hal qilamiz.

definition_en: To ask for help when you don't need it, so nobody believes you later.
example_en: If you cry wolf too often, no one will come.
example_uz: Bekorga vahima ko'taraversangiz, keyin hech kim kelmaydi.

definition_en: Being too curious can get you into trouble.
example_en: Stop asking — curiosity killed the cat.

definition_en: To talk about the important thing without delay.
example_en: Let's cut to the chase: how much will it cost?
example_uz: Gapni lo'nda qilaylik: bu qancha turadi?

definition_en: Someone who argues the opposite side to test an idea.
example_en: I'll play devil's advocate: what if the plan fails?
example_uz: Ataylab qarshi chiqay: reja barbod bo'lsa-chi?

headword: don't judge a book by its cover
definition_en: Do not judge by appearance alone.
ipa: dəʊnt dʒʌdʒ ə bʊk baɪ ɪts ˈkʌvə
example_en: He looks strict, but don't judge a book by its cover.
example_uz: U qattiqqo'l ko'rinadi, lekin tashqi ko'rinishga qarab baholamang.

headword: don't put all your eggs in one basket
translation_ru: не клади все яйца в одну корзину
definition_en: Do not risk everything on a single plan.
ipa: dəʊnt pʊt ɔːl jɔːr eɡz ɪn wʌn ˈbɑːskɪt
example_en: Apply to several universities — don't put all your eggs in one basket.
example_uz: Bir nechta universitetga topshiring — hammasini bittasiga tikmang.

definition_en: To set a limit on what you will accept.
example_en: I help colleagues, but I draw the line at doing their work.
example_uz: Hamkasblarga yordam beraman, lekin ularning ishini qilishga chegara qo'yaman.

definition_en: To annoy someone very much.
example_en: That noise is driving me up the wall.

definition_en: Someone who wakes up or arrives early.
example_en: My grandfather is an early bird — up at five.
example_uz: Bobom erta turadigan odam — beshda uyg'onadi.

definition_en: A big obvious problem that nobody wants to discuss.
example_en: The budget cuts were the elephant in the room.
example_uz: Byudjet qisqarishi — hamma bilib turib gapirmagan muammo edi.

definition_en: Very rare and not happening often.
example_en: Sunny days are few and far between this winter.
example_uz: Bu qishda quyoshli kunlar juda kam.

definition_en: Someone uncomfortable in an unfamiliar situation.
example_en: At the fancy party he felt like a fish out of water.
example_uz: Dabdabali bazmda u o'zini suvdan chiqqan baliqday his qildi.

definition_en: Something worth thinking about carefully.
example_en: Her lecture gave us plenty of food for thought.
example_uz: Uning ma'ruzasi bizga o'ylashga ko'p ozuqa berdi.

definition_en: From the very beginning, using nothing ready-made.
example_en: She baked the cake from scratch.

headword: get off on the wrong foot
definition_en: To start a relationship badly.
ipa: ɡet ɒf ɒn ðə rɒŋ fʊt
example_en: We got off on the wrong foot, but now we're friends.
example_uz: Boshida chiqisha olmadik, endi esa do'stmiz.

definition_en: To deliberately ignore someone.
example_en: After the argument she gave me the cold shoulder.
example_uz: Janjaldan keyin u menga sovuq munosabatda bo'ldi.

definition_en: To accept things as they happen without resisting.
example_en: Relax and go with the flow on holiday.

definition_en: Keep trying and don't give up in a hard time.
example_en: Hang in there — exams will be over soon.
example_uz: Bardosh bering — imtihonlar tez orada tugaydi.

definition_en: To love eating sweet things.
example_en: I can't refuse cake — I have a sweet tooth.

definition_en: Completely in love.
example_en: He's head over heels in love with her.

definition_en: Wait and be patient before acting.
example_en: Hold your horses — we haven't checked the facts yet.

definition_en: Said very briefly, in a few words.
example_en: In a nutshell, the project was a success.

headword: in the heat of the moment
definition_en: Said or done quickly because of strong emotion.
ipa: ɪn ðə hiːt əv ðə ˈməʊmənt
example_en: He said it in the heat of the moment and later apologised.
example_uz: U jahl ustida aytib yubordi va keyin uzr so'radi.

translation_uz: ikkovlon aybdor — bir qo'ldan ovoz chiqmas
definition_en: Both people share responsibility for a situation.
example_en: Don't blame only him — it takes two to tango.
example_uz: Faqat uni ayblamang — bir qo'ldan ovoz chiqmaydi.

definition_en: To act too soon, before the right time.
example_en: They jumped the gun and announced it too early.
example_uz: Ular shoshib e'lonni juda erta qilishdi.

definition_en: To watch someone or something carefully.
example_en: Can you keep an eye on my bag for a minute?
example_uz: Bir daqiqa sumkamga ko'z-quloq bo'lib tura olasizmi?

definition_en: To try every possible way to achieve something.
example_en: Police left no stone unturned in the search.
example_uz: Politsiya qidiruvda hamma yo'lni sinab ko'rdi.

translation_ru: не буди лихо пока оно тихо
definition_en: To avoid restarting an old problem.
example_en: Don't mention the old argument — let sleeping dogs lie.
example_uz: Eski janjalni eslatmang — eski yarani qo'zg'amang.

definition_en: To not notice how much time has passed.
example_en: Reading that book, I completely lost track of time.
example_uz: O'sha kitobni o'qib, vaqt o'tganini butunlay sezmay qolibman.

definition_en: To have just enough money to live.
example_en: With two jobs she barely makes ends meet.
example_uz: Ikki ish bilan u zo'rg'a ro'zg'or tebratadi.

translation_ru: без труда не выловишь и рыбку из пруда
definition_en: You must work hard to get results.
example_en: Training is hard, but no pain, no gain.
example_uz: Mashg'ulot og'ir, lekin mehnatsiz rohat yo'q.

definition_en: Something you do not enjoy or like.
example_en: Horror films are not my cup of tea.

definition_en: Far from popular places, where few people go.
example_en: We found a lovely village off the beaten track.
example_uz: Kam odam boradigan ajoyib qishloq topdik.

definition_en: Quick to understand and react well.
example_en: Our new manager is really on the ball.

headword: on the tip of my tongue
definition_en: When you almost remember a word but not quite.
ipa: ɒn ðə tɪp əv maɪ tʌŋ
example_en: Her name is on the tip of my tongue.

definition_en: Extremely happy about something.
example_en: She was over the moon about the new job.
example_uz: Yangi ishdan uning boshi osmonga yetdi.

definition_en: Doing something many times makes you good at it.
example_en: Keep writing every day — practice makes perfect.
example_uz: Har kuni yozishda davom eting — takrorlash mahorat onasi.

definition_en: To control your feelings and behave calmly.
example_en: Pull yourself together — the interview starts soon.
example_uz: O'zingizni qo'lga oling — suhbat boshlanay deyapti.

definition_en: To imagine being in another person's situation.
example_en: Put yourself in her shoes before you judge.
example_uz: Hukm chiqarishdan oldin o'zingizni uning o'rniga qo'yib ko'ring.

definition_en: Raining very heavily.
example_en: Take an umbrella — it's raining cats and dogs.

definition_en: To sound familiar but not clearly remembered.
example_en: That name rings a bell, but I can't place it.
example_uz: Bu ism tanish tuyulyapti, lekin eslay olmayapman.

definition_en: To cause problems by changing a calm situation.
example_en: Don't rock the boat before the deal is signed.

definition_en: To wait until the next day before deciding.
example_en: Don't answer now — sleep on it.
example_uz: Hozir javob bermang — bir kecha o'ylab ko'ring.

definition_en: To feel that something is wrong or dishonest.
example_en: The offer was too good — I smelled a rat.
example_uz: Taklif haddan tashqari yaxshi edi — shubha sezdim.

definition_en: Everything has gone well until now.
example_en: How's the new job? So far so good.
example_uz: Yangi ish qanday? Hozircha hammasi joyida.
